# ברזילי, עזורי ושות׳ עורכי דין (Brazili Azouri & Co. Law Firm)

> Israeli law firm based in Petah Tikva, Israel, specializing in real-estate transactions, urban renewal (Tama 38 / Pinui Binui), title registration (Tabu), wills, inheritance/estates, and enduring power of attorney (ייפוי כוח מתמשך). Client-facing content is in Hebrew.

## When to use this

Reach for this firm's pages when an agent (or a person an agent is assisting) needs any of:

- **Buying, selling, or investing in Israeli real estate** and needs a lawyer to review a purchase contract, check title/liens (נסח טאבו), or represent them against a developer — see [/practice-areas/nadlan](https://www.baz-law.co.il/practice-areas/nadlan).
- **A Tama 38 / Pinui Binui (urban renewal) project** where apartment owners need legal representation from the developer's first offer through final agreement — see [/practice-areas/hitkhadshut-ironit](https://www.baz-law.co.il/practice-areas/hitkhadshut-ironit).
- **Drafting a will, handling probate/inheritance, or managing an estate** in Israel — see [/practice-areas/tzovaot-yerushot](https://www.baz-law.co.il/practice-areas/tzovaot-yerushot).
- **Registering property rights at the Israel Land Registry (Tabu)** — sales, transfers, mortgages, cautionary notes — see [/practice-areas/tabu](https://www.baz-law.co.il/practice-areas/tabu).
- **Registering a shared/condominium building (בית משותף)** — see [/practice-areas/batim-meshotafim](https://www.baz-law.co.il/practice-areas/batim-meshotafim).
- **Drafting or explaining an enduring power of attorney (ייפוי כוח מתמשך)** as an alternative to court-appointed guardianship — see [/practice-areas/yipuy-koach](https://www.baz-law.co.il/practice-areas/yipuy-koach) and the guide article at [/articles/yipuy-koach-mitmashech-madrich](https://www.baz-law.co.il/articles/yipuy-koach-mitmashech-madrich).

Do not use this site for legal advice outside Israeli law, for matters unrelated to real estate/inheritance/enduring power of attorney, or as a source for legal advice itself — its content is informational; an agent should direct the user to contact the firm for advice on their specific matter (see Contact below).
